title: Astro's Void-Glass Dragon Boss
description: A high-quality, translucent Void-Glass Dragon model featuring Aqua wireframes and Pink glow accents for the ultimate boss experience.
body: # Astro's Void-Glass Dragon A high-performance **Resource Pack** featuring a custom 3D model. This isn't just a re-texture; it's a full wireframe overhaul of the Ender Dragon. ### What's Inside: * **Custom Model:** Translucent glass body with energy-pulsing wings. * **Colors:** Optimized with Aqua and Pink glow highlights. * **Compatibility:** Works as a standard resource pack or with **ItemsAdder** / **ModelEngine**. --- **Created by:** astro89573
